description: This file defines a class 'StripeTool_Tools' implementing the 'INode' interface, representing a tool for interacting with Stripe via function calling. It includes initialization logic to set up actions based on user inputs and credentials, and exports the class as a module.

classes.name: StripeTool_Tools
classes.description: A class implementing INode, representing a Stripe integration tool with configurable actions and initialization logic.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the StripeTool_Tools instance with predefined labels, inputs, credentials, and base classes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the tool by fetching credentials, processing user input options into actions, creating a StripeAgentToolkit instance, and returning configured tools.
